question: Which of the following members of the animal kingdom has a four-chambered heart?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Birds.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Birds have a **chambered heart.**
 
• Reptiles and Amphibians also usually have 3 chambered hearts.
 
• **Crocodiles **have a complete four-chambered heart.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Most reptiles have two atria and one ventricle. 
 
• **Four Chambers of the heart are:__**
 
 
• ​**T****he left atrium and right atrium (upper chambers).**
 
• **The left ventricle and right ventricle (lower chambers)**.
